text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: INCIDENT detected 1749876543 - GPU capacity pressure in eu-west-1. Pool 'eu-gpu-pool-3' queue length 12.4k, avg wait 18s, throttled requests spiking. Autoscaler attempted scale -> 48 nodes and failed: scale_limit_hit. Notifying on-call.

sre-oncall-jay: I'm on pager. +1. Starting triage. Any immediate mitigation we can flip?

eng-runtime-maya: I see steady enqueue rate from a set of customers ramping. KV cache hit rate low for these requests. GPU utilization at 98% on pool-3. Autoscaler logs show repeated `scaleUp failed: quota_exceeded` from cloud provider.

eng-autoscale-li: Confirming. Cloud provider responded 403 on create VM: "quota vCPU limit reached". We have burst capacity configured but provider account cap is hard. Trying fallback to other regions.

platform-elaine: Rolling policy: we have a cross-region fallback that can route to eu-gpu-pool-1 but models there are a different variant (quantized) and might increase latency. Do we want automatic failover or manual? Risk: customer-visible degradation.

sre-oncall-jay: For immediate mitigation, can we enable aggressive prefix caching for high-volume customers and enable sampling-based throttling to reduce queue growth? Also open a support ticket with provider to request emergency quota increase.

eng-runtime-maya: I can enable prefix/KV caching for the top 3 request patterns. Pushing patch now:

```
# enable aggressive prefix caching
PATCH /runtime/config
{"pool":"eu-gpu-pool-3","prefix_cache":{"enabled":true,"ttl_ms":60000}}
```

eng-autoscale-li: I'll try to patch autoscaler policy to allow cross-pool bursting and set a temporary tolerance so scale doesn't abort on single-zone failures.

infra-bot: provider ticket created: TICKET-9823. Severity: critical. Contacting account manager.

prod-support-ash: Notifying customers with active jobs in queue > 10k. Draft message to customers:
"We're experiencing elevated inference queue times in eu-west-1 due to cloud quota limits. We're routing traffic and applying temporary caching and throttles to reduce impact. We'll update in 30 minutes."

customer-success-ravi: Sending targeted pings to top 5 affected customers to coordinate potential rate limiting on their side.

sre-oncall-jay: Actions executed: 1) prefix caching enabled (maya) 2) autoscaler tolerances patched (li) 3) fallback routing configured but not enabled (elaine) 4) provider ticket open (infra-bot) 5) customer comms sent (ash/ravi). Monitoring.

eng-runtime-maya: After cache patch: queue dropped from 12.4k -> 7.1k in 4m. P95 latency improved ~12%. Some long-running inferences still stuck because of model footprint >16GB; those don't benefit from prefix cache.

eng-autoscale-li: Attempted cross-region burst to eu-gpu-pool-1 but blocked by account network policies. Working with platform-elaine to relax route guard for emergency.

platform-elaine: Temporary route relaxation applied. Starting gradual traffic shift (5% -> 20%). Watch for model mismatch errors.

sre-oncall-jay: Noting customer-visible errors: a handful of requests returned fallback-model-warning or slight tokenization diffs. Product/CS to capture examples.

prod-support-ash: Collected 4 example traces. Uploading to shared drive link: https://redwood.internal/drive/incident/1749876543/traces

eng-runtime-maya: Applying a quick mitigate: reduce max_concurrent_chunks for long-running jobs to free up slots.

```
# limited concurrency for heavy models
PATCH /jobs/config
{"max_concurrent_chunks": 2, "target_models":["/models/*-long-*"]}
```

sre-oncall-jay: Good. Queue now trending 7.1k -> 3.2k over 12 minutes. Autoscaler still showing failed creates but less immediate pressure.

infra-bot: Provider updated ticket: emergency quota increase approved for 30 instances. ETA provisioning 14m.

eng-autoscale-li: When provider boots finish, autoscaler should pick up. We'll keep cross-region burst enabled until pool pressure gone.

customer-success-ravi: Customers acknowledged comms, two asked for SLA credits. Recording requests.

platform-elaine: Post-incident plan idea: add an emergency capacity reserve (pre-paid) and a soft-fallback model orchestration that transparently returns quantized variant with "best-effort" header to caller.

sre-oncall-jay: Good candidate action item. Also add better quota alerting (predictive) and runbook update: include provider account owner contact + fast path for emergency quota.

eng-runtime-maya: Logging action items: 1) auto-prefix-cache tuning per workload, 2) concurrency limits for heavy models, 3) better model-variant routing for cross-region fallback, 4) add scoring to detect when cache will help. I'll file PRs.

eng-autoscale-li: My action items: 1) autoscaler retry/backoff improvements on provider quota errors, 2) emergency-route quick-enable toggle, 3) integration test simulating provider quota.

platform-elaine: My action items: 1) add route guard bypass for validated oncall, 2) ensure model compatibility map between regions, 3) run a chaos test for quota failure.

prod-support-ash: CS/Support action items: 1) standard incident customer template, 2) SLA credit process doc update, 3) follow-up emails to impacted customers with timeline.

sre-oncall-jay: Final status update: pressure reduced, queue 3.2k, autoscaler still in-prog. Will keep this thread open until provider quota fully reflected and queues under normal thresholds. Handing to eng-runtime and autoscale teams for postmortem.

eng-runtime-maya: Leaving notes in incident tracker: INC-1749876543. Will include metrics snapshots and traces.

prod-support-ash: Closing customer comms loop in 2 hours with root cause summary and next steps.

sre-oncall-jay: Thanks everyone. If anything spikes re-open page. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: INCIDENT update 1749877120 - severity moved to mitigated. Queue down, monitoring.
